clips.title: The story
paras: In Duskwood, Burning Blood is gathered from the Nightbane worgen. Grimand Elmore needs twenty vials for experiments in smithing.

Nightbane worgen prowl Duskwood with a strange fury, and their blood burns with real heat. The fluid can be drawn from worgen haunting the timberlands and Roland's Doom. Though foul to gather, its heat draws the interest of armorers seeking to temper resilient plate.

Grimand Elmore works as an armorer in Stormwind's Dwarven District. He wants to test smithing methods developed by his former student Furen Longbeard. For the experiment, Elmore needs Burning Blood and a dense burning rock held by the worgen chieftain Gutspill. Those who bring back the bubbling fluid are promised sturdy warrior armor from his forge.
